datasets.title: Locust habitat suitability map
datasets.description: This map has been produced by training a random forest model using bioclimatic variables, sand concentration in soil, elevation and landcover features ; and locust larvae observations from the Locust Hub in the North East of Africa. Maps are available for the baseline (1995-2014), 2050 SSP2-4.5, 2050 SSP5-8.5, 2085 SSP2-4.5 and 2085 SSP5-8.5.
datasets.purpose: This dataset was developed during the first phase of GRMA's project in Madagascar. This project aimed at updating Madagascar's risk profile, and see the risk evolution under climate change.

resources.title: WorldClim 2 Bioclimatic Variables
resources.description: Bioclimatic variables downscaled at 30 arcsec for present and future climate from 6 CMIP6 models

resources.title: SoilGrids250m 2.0 - Sand Content
resources.description: Sand content mass fraction in per mille at 6 standard depths, resampled to 1000m

resources.title: FAO Locust Hub - Larvae Observations
resources.description: Desert locust observation data from FAO. Nymphs in North West Africa used to train the random forest model.

sources.name: WorldClim 2
sources.description: WorldClim 2 dataset offers bioclimatic variables downscaled at 30 arcsec for present climate and future ones using 6 climate models (ACCESS-CM2, ACCESS-ESM1-5, IPSL, MIROC, MPI, MRI). More information on the dataset construction can be found here: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. International Journal of Climatology 37 (12): 4302-4315.

sources.name: SoilGrids250m 2.0 - Sand content aggregated 1000m
sources.description: Sand content (50/63-2000 micro meter) mass fraction in ‰ at 6 standard depths. Predictions were derived using a digital soil mapping approach based on Quantile Random Forest, drawing on a global compilation of soil profile data and environmental layers. This map is the result of resampling the mean SoilGrids 250 m predictions (Poggio et al. 2021) for each 1000 m cell.

sources.name: WorldClim 2 Elevation
sources.description: The layer gives the surface elevation with a resolution of 30 arcsec. More information can be found here: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. International Journal of Climatology 37 (12): 4302-4315.

sources.name: FAO Locust Hub
sources.description: The Locust Hub is the authoritative repository for desert locust data managed by FAO. The data is updated frequently with the latest observations from the field.
sources.lineage: Only nymphs in the North West part of Africa were used to train the model.
